title: Navigation Performance & Carousel
changes: Removed the permanent dashboard refresh timer that was doing work every 2.5 seconds.
Removed the whole-document MutationObserver and full-page Japanese recolouring pass that made navigation sluggish on phones.
Restricted UI observers to the small lesson/game containers that actually change.
Changed dashboard and Today-summary updates to event-driven refreshes.
Removed the explicit 'Swipe here to switch Journey / Japan Ready' instruction.
Replaced the Journey / Japan Ready selector with a native horizontal scroll-snap carousel.
The active study-mode card now shows part of the neighbouring card, creating the standard mobile visual cue that it can be swiped.
Added subtle page indicators below the carousel; tapping the visible neighbouring card or its dot also changes study mode.
Retains the v11.7 Today summary, Japanese script colouring, Kana overlay feedback and Keep Learning panel.
Bumped release-controlled assets and service-worker caches to v11.7.1.
